mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy shift, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, signaling economic weakness that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO and HOUST decline fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a deceleration in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 deceleration in late-cycle expansion periods fails to produce negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it triggers fears of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days due to increased discount rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weakness in employment growth (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based consumption slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue outlook deteriorates.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS and RSAFS decline fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
